name: M7.FinalSelector.invalid_rejection
statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query), (¬ M7.DefaultQuery.valid N q) → (∀ x : M7.FinalSelector.Index N w q, M7.FinalSelector.answer q x = Except.error M7.DefaultQuery.QueryError.invalidSignature) ∧ (¬ ∃ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, M7.FinalSelector.RawFeasible w q c)
guidance: answer checks actual DefaultQuery.valid first; RawFeasible contains actual DefaultQuery.feasible, whose first conjunct is validity. No weight hypotheses are needed for invalid rejection. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.
